steps.text: SUVAT equations describe constant-acceleration motion: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as.
Horizontal and vertical motions are independent; only gravity acts on a projectile.
Horizontal velocity is constant, so equal-time horizontal gaps are equal.
Vertical displacement grows as t², so gaps in equal times follow 1 : 3 : 5 : 7 …
Time of flight depends only on the vertical motion, never on horizontal speed.
Free fall from rest: s = ½gt²; after 1 s, 2 s, 3 s the distances are in the ratio 1 : 4 : 9.
